description: iOS-first React Native UI component library with Tailwind CSS / NativeWind preset and theming for Expo
rules: iOS only — do not add Android or web platform checks
Use NativeWind className for styling, never StyleSheet.create
Import components as flat named exports: import { Card, CardHeader } from '@byarcadia-app/aether'
Icons use a separate entrypoint: import { IconSymbol } from '@byarcadia-app/aether/icons'
Tailwind preset uses a separate entrypoint: import { preset } from '@byarcadia-app/aether/tailwind-preset'
Wrap app root with AetherProvider for theming, animations, and text config
Use semantic color tokens (bg-primary, text-foreground) not raw color values
Use cnx() for className merging when accepting className from props, cn() for simple concatenation
All components use tailwind-variants (tv()) for styling — variant constants are exported
Compound components (Card, TextField, List) require sub-components nested inside their parent
Button accepts render function children for context-aware content: {(ctx) => ctx.isLoading ? '...' : 'Go'}
Animations use react-native-reanimated — check useAnimationDisabled() to respect accessibility
Use useThemeColor() for resolved color values; useNavigationTheme() for React Navigation theming
HStack and VStack accept a polymorphic as prop to render as any component
